judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a definition-of-done file, updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and added a new acceptance test file `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.usage.acceptance.test.ts`. Crucially, it completely omitted any implementation changes in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and failed to update `CHANGELOG.md`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still overwrites `lastUsage` instead of accumulating `totalUsage`, the newly added tests in the candidate's diff will immediately fail when `npm test` is run. Additionally, the hook signature in `OrchestratorHooks` was never updated to `totalUsage`.
